proposed_widenings.name: charge_pool_alternative_mode
proposed_widenings.justification: The Poisoned-removal use expends a fixed 5 charges from the same pool as the variable-cost heal use. Two distinct bonus-action activations share one pool but with different per-activation charge costs. Neither a second ActivatedAbilityMechanics (would declare a separate pool) nor a CastTimeEffectModeChoice (no per-option charge cost) can represent this. Needed: a way to declare alternative activation effects on the same pool with their own fixed charge cost.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can also expend 5 Hit Points from the pool of healing power to remove the Poisoned condition from the creature; those points don't also restore Hit Points to the creature.

proposed_widenings.name: range_on_ActivatedAbilityMechanics
proposed_widenings.justification: ActivatedAbilityMechanics has no range field; the tracer hardcodes range: { kind: 'self' } for all class features. Lay on Hands requires Touch range (the paladin must physically touch the creature). The trace labels the attachment 'range Self' which is factually wrong. TriggeredReactionAbilityMechanics and MagicItemSpawnedCreatureMechanics both carry a range field — ActivatedAbilityMechanics should too.
proposed_widenings.evidence: As a Bonus Action, you can touch a creature (which could be yourself) and draw power from the pool of healing.

notes: Primary mechanic (heal HP = resource_spent from charge_pool with linear_per_level cap) typechecks and traces cleanly. The secondary mechanic (remove Poisoned at fixed 5-charge cost from the same pool) is omitted because the surface has no shared-pool, two-mode pattern with different per-activation charge costs. Additionally, the tracer labels the target attachment 'range Self' instead of 'range Touch' because ActivatedAbilityMechanics lacks a range field. Both gaps are surface_widening: all atoms involved (heal, remove_condition, charge) exist in v4; what's missing is the variant/field to wire them together correctly.
